goal: Patrol discovery of visible ground-lying/collapsed people; observing the transition from standing is NOT required

gt_policy.pixel_alignment_basis: user attestation; no claim of exhaustive independent verification

primary.development_cache: Only exact input/prompt/policy/model/preprocess-bound historical V4 records; not new V5 inference

secondary.scope: full-scene evidence of possible missed ground-lying persons
secondary.trigger: all primary non-ALERT decisions, not only detector-count>1

future_development.historical_screen_role: development regression ONLY; not independent SCREEN
future_development.canary: if used, charge against the same manifests/budget and reuse identical completed responses; no extra repeat

additional_proposed_operational_guard.reason: Do not pass safety coverage by sending every normal frame to RECHECK
additional_proposed_operational_guard.auxiliary_and_uncertain: report separately; neither may be laundered into determinate-negative/ground-lying metrics

patrol_reobservation.proposal: a RECHECK asks the patrol controller for a fresh observation or safe alternative view, then reuse the unchanged primary; bounded by a separately configured time/frame budget
patrol_reobservation.stale_recheck: report unresolved visual uncertainty, not silent NO_ALERT and not fabricated confirmed fall
patrol_reobservation.warning: static AIGC does not measure event closure or robot response latency

independent_validation.existing_val_independence: NOT_ASSUMED; historical exposure/split audit required without inspecting image/prediction content for design

historical_results: REV15 remains rejected; V4-A0 remains SCREEN_FAIL; no release winner
stop_rule: No candidate/inference until branch contract and bindings are frozen; a clean metric failure closes this V5 candidate, infrastructure failures are distinct and never silently retried
